feature_definitions.position_qual: Qualifying rank; missing qualifying falls back to grid, or 20 for no grid
feature_definitions.driver_rolling_perf: Mean classified finish in previous five completed races; 10.5 cold start
feature_definitions.team_rolling_perf: Mean of both classified teammate finishes per race, then previous five completed team races; 10.5 cold start

target: Classified finishing position, including retired drivers; not elapsed race time
model: Gradient Boosting, 100 estimators, depth 2; Platt probability calibration on latter 2024 races
limitations: Historical backtest; no proof of future predictive accuracy
No weather, incidents, pit strategy or circuit features in ML
Missing qualifying uses a labelled grid fallback
No model selection on held-out 2025 results
